name: Expressing Opinions
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on expressing opinions — practice these key phrases out loud:
In my opinion, that's the better option.
I see it a bit differently, actually.
That's a fair point, but I still think...
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
